text: ‘Election results are rarely predictable.’ Discuss.
To what extent should schools be allowed to decide their own curriculum? [30]
To what extent has the world become a ‘global village’? [30]
‘In the digital age, we are more reliably informed than we have ever been.’ To what extent do you
agree? [30]
‘Our oceans are becoming choked with plastic debris, causing damage to all forms of life.’ Evaluate
the possible solutions to this environmental issue. [30]
To what extent do you agree that tourists should not be encouraged to visit remote parts of the
world? [30]
‘Scientific research and development could eventually increase human life expectancy to 150 years.’
To what extent is this desirable in your country? [30]
‘Sculpture has existed since early times.’ Evaluate the cultural significance of this art form.
Examine whether or not the reading of fiction enhances our understanding of human nature. You
should refer to novels you have read. [30]
Examine whether objects that are used every day should be beautiful as well as useful.
